request.prompt: Create exactly one complete two-step side-view walk-in-place cycle spanning the entire clip from the first frame to the final frame. Motion begins immediately from the supplied front-foot contact pose and continues at a perfectly uniform metronomic cadence. The opposite-foot contact occurs exactly halfway through the clip, and the character arrives at the supplied matching contact pose on the final frame while maintaining continuous motion. The clip contains only this single cycle. Every frame is an active gait phase. Keep the pelvis centered, with clear contact, down, passing, and up phases and a natural close arm swing. Character faces screen-left in flat side profile on a clean white background with a static eye-level camera. Maintain the character appearance, clothing, rope, pouch, proportions, scale, and lighting.
